programmes.d: The team take on one of the grandest properties in Great Britain, Liverpool’s Croxteth Hall in a non-stop two-hour heart pounding investigation.

We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The team seem to be stalked by something…but what. Only time will tell what awaits them in the upper corridors of this once grand mansion.

The team head to the centre of Shrewsbury and a large building that is all but empty. The house is now said to be full of the long dead just wanting to make itself known and that is exactly what they did.
A haunted old building in West Yorkshire almost halts the investigation due to violent poltergeist activity. The team must decide whether to continue, and when they do, the situation worsens.
This episode features the following cases: The Wall, The Chalkboard, The Getaway, The Prescription, Summer Camp.
This episode features the following cases: The Warning, Bus Stop, The Cure, The Guardian, The Gift.
This episode features the following cases: For the Record, Halloween, Precious, Get Your Kicks at Motel 66, Phantom Drifter.
This episode features the following cases: The Wealthy Widow, The Witness, The Accident, Bad Dreams, Mental.
This episode features the following cases: The Apparition, The Electric Chair, On the Road, Number One with a Bullet, Dream House.
Orange Is The New Black's Alysia Reiner begs for Psychic Medium Kim Russo's help in confronting spirits in her Harlem Brownstone that are terrorizing her young daughter.

Actor Johnathon Schaech (That Thing You Do!, Texas Rising) anxiously returns to an old theater in Austin, Texas where he had a harrowing and life-changing paranormal experience. With psychic medium Kim Russo by his side.
Author, journalist and Real Housewife Carole Radziwill returns to the Hamptons, New York beach home where she once encountered a ghostly presence.
World famous singer-songwriter, Kesha revisits the Texas bed and breakfast where she encountered a paranormal apparition so tortured and disturbed it haunts her to this day.
Prolific film star, Eric Roberts almost lost his life in a tragic accident at the start of his career.
Well-loved actress, Charisma Carpenter (Buffy the Vampire Slayer) returns to her childhood home in Las Vegas where she was terrorized by an unknown entity for years.
Shelley Long confronts civil war spirits. Daniel Stern and his wife vacation in a haunted town. Gail O'Grady receives a reassuring message from her deceased brother.
Battling with inner demons after retiring, Sugar Ray Leonard is awoken one evening by the appearance of a mysterious young girl.

An old house in England’s West Midlands gives the Most Haunted team a night they will never forget. Yvette is under attack by something that wants to gain her attention and the team catch one of the best pieces of evidence to date.

The strange occurrences at Hayden Hill House switch up a gear as whatever is there seems now to be stalking the team with some terrifying results, at least for some of the crew it is proving too much.

This week Yvette Fielding takes her Most Haunted team to Coalville and a house that is surrounded by mystery. The team seem to disturb the rest of some of its long-term residence as they battle through a night of terror.
Once an old foundry, this large old building houses vehicles from a bygone era that are said to still contain passengers whose destination has never ended.
Yvette heads to Presteigne, Mid Wales and the famous Judges Lodgings, were courts were held, people imprisoned and Judges stayed, but it also holds many a secret.
Most Haunted continues its investigation into the Judges Lodgings where the team seem to be under attack and something is trying to get through a door…but what?

The team venture into a cottage where it is said ‘no living soul can endure living there’. With cursed dolls, murder and suicide this derelict place has everything to fear, and the team were not disappointed.

We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The foreboding Codnor Castle Cottage maintains its attack on the Most Haunted team with dramatic effect causing Yvette calls an early end to their night in Hell House.
